title: bug: both launchers pin MOE_ATTEMPT_ID in pre-flight and never re-check it after a long MOE_ACCOUNT_WAIT, so a QA seat launches its CLI with a closed attempt and every qa_approve is refused ATTEMPT_SUPERSEDED (wrapper follow-up that task-0c78c290 scoped out)
description:
Reported by the UnAI fleet's governor (governor-e3e66307) and relayed by the human on 2026-11-03 at 17:17Z. Spec with the full timeline: /tmp/claude-1000/-mnt-d-projexts-UnAI/8f70449b-256d-492b-8747-d60955dcf5a6/scratchpad/moe-defect-stale-attempt-pin-after-account-wait.md (/tmp may be wiped, so the key facts are copied below).

SYMPTOM (UnAI, 2026-11-03, after the all-accounts-spent window 09:39-11:30Z). Two QA seats ran full review gates, and then every moe.qa_approve was refused:
- qa-94c91c2b on task-d8f9feee: `[ATTEMPT_SUPERSEDED] ... caller presented attempt-7bd7ed75... (generation 6), current attempt is attempt-2bb9e249... (generation 8)`.
- qa-02e57990 on task-f4da64ff: the same refusal, gen 3 vs gen 4.
- Passing the live attemptId explicitly is refused by the proxy: `moe.qa_approve: attemptId differs from this session's MOE_ATTEMPT_ID; omit attemptId so the proxy supplies the session's own value`.
So the session cannot record any verdict. In UnAI, three QA sessions were spent on one row; only the next wrapper iteration recovered.

TIMELINE (qa-94c91c2b):
- 09:17 pre-flight claims the row and opens gen 6.
- 09:39 all accounts are spent and the CLI exits 1.
- ~09:40 the next pre-flight resumes (alreadyAssigned), pins gen 6, bakes the prompt, then sleeps in get_account_lease (MOE_ACCOUNT_WAIT, "the held task stays held").
- 10:13 no heartbeat has run yet (the sidecar starts after the lease). The REVIEW self-heal (WORKER_TIMEOUT) unassigns the row and closes gen 6; another QA seat claims it (gen 7).
- 11:30 the account frees. The wrapper launches the CLI with the 09:40 prompt and MOE_ATTEMPT_ID = gen 6.
- 11:31 the agent re-claims by id and the daemon opens gen 8, but the proxy keeps stamping gen 6.
- 11:38 qa_approve is refused after about 10 min of gate work.

CAUSE, verified on moe/work-2026-10-24 at 19d5e67a:
- scripts/moe-agent.sh: pin_attempt_identity runs at :10011 in pre-flight; get_account_lease runs at :10741; start_heartbeat_sidecar runs at :10747. Nothing re-verifies the pin after the lease returns, however long it slept. The wait message at :9142 (MOE_ACCOUNT_WAIT) and :9131 (MOE_ACCOUNT_UNTRUSTED) promise "the held task stays held".
- scripts/moe-agent.ps1 has the same order: Set-MoeAttemptIdentity at :9534, Get-MoeAccountLease at :10067, Start-HeartbeatSidecar afterwards (:10143 and the other call sites), and the same messages at :8824 and :8813.
- WORKING and PLANNING rows are never idle-released, so only REVIEW (QA) pins die this way, but any release or re-claim during a wait kills a pin the same way.

RELATION TO task-0c78c290 (DONE). That daemon fix counts every lease_account poll as presence, so the 30-min REVIEW self-heal no longer releases a waiting seat's row. It removes this timeline's usual trigger. It is not live on the moes board yet: it ships in the staged daemon build 6029cee3, waiting on the human's swap. Other projects get it only with a new plugin build. Its row explicitly left "a wrapper-side re-check of the claim before launching after a long wait" to a follow-up row, which is this one. Even with 0c78c290 live, the CLI must never start on a closed attempt or on a prompt baked before a multi-hour wait.

FIX DIRECTION (the planner decides):
- Required, in both launchers ("both twins or neither"): after the account lease returns from any wait, re-verify the pinned attempt (sh: moe_attempt_read "$MOE_ATTEMPT_ID" "$MOE_ATTEMPT_GENERATION"; ps1: Read-MoeAttempt). If it is closed or superseded, do not start the CLI: restart the iteration, so pre-flight claims again and fetches fresh context.
- Optional: start the heartbeat during the wait, or change the wait messages so they no longer promise a hold the wrapper doesn't keep. If the banners change, keep the two twins' strings identical (parity-check).
- Optional, and separate: the proxy could adopt the attempt from a claim_next_task reply it relayed for this session (packages/moe-proxy/src). That touches the execution-identity fence, so if you want it, split it into its own off-lane row rather than adding it here.

PLACEMENT. Worktree mode, so no dependsOn on the CQ-M07 lane. The CQ-M07 rows are editing the same two files right now: 91ee455a (moe-agent.sh) and 65b3e023 (moe-agent.ps1).
- Put the re-check in its own small function next to the lease function, with one call line after the lease. Don't reflow the launch block, so the merge-tree landing stays clean.
- Put the regression tests in new test files, not scripts/tests/postflight.ps1 (65b3e023 holds it) or postflight-vm-route.* (the CQ-M07 lane).
- Edit the launchers with a TOOL-witnessed editor and then run bash -n / ParseFile. Never use temp + mv.
definitionOfDone: In scripts/moe-agent.sh and scripts/moe-agent.ps1, when the account lease returns after a wait, the pinned attempt is re-verified before the CLI starts. When it is closed or superseded, the CLI does not start from the pre-wait prompt: the iteration re-runs pre-flight (fresh claim and context). When the lease did not wait, the path is unchanged.

A regression test for each launcher, in new test files under scripts/tests/, reproduces the defect: a fake proxy closes the pinned attempt during the lease wait. The test fails on 19d5e67a (RED evidence in a task comment) and passes with the fix.
bash -n scripts/moe-agent.sh and a ParseFile check of scripts/moe-agent.ps1 pass, and so does bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh. Any wait-message wording change is identical in both twins.

implementationPlan.note: Created scripts/tests/account-wait-attempt.test.mjs, byte-identical to the reference (sha256 cdf71c64). Added the +2 idle_wait cut to the moe-account-lease.test.mjs shLeaseScript, and the CI line entry. RED is posted as comment-f5a1969d: on 19d5e67a and on 195b656a, WSL fails 2/4 and Windows 6/12; the stale rows print LAUNCH ... attempt-a.

implementationPlan.description:
ps1 twin (DoD 1, both twins or neither). Edit scripts/moe-agent.ps1 in place with your TOOL-witnessed editor, keeping its UTF-8 BOM. Reference: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-a7d0/ref/moe-agent.ps1.ref (sha256 c502f17a9d16c20ef14d7d2618549ae22f0c4156a271cfc2bda8f49a29b71bcf). +26 lines, inserts only. The description's ps1 line numbers are ~88 lines stale; these are current at 19d5e67a.
(1) Get-MoeAccountLease (8853):
- `$script:AccountLeaseWaited = $false` as its first line;
- `$script:AccountLeaseWaited = $true` before `Start-Sleep -Seconds $trustSec` (8903);
- `$script:AccountLeaseWaited = $true` before `Start-Sleep -Seconds $waitSec` (8910).
(2) A new function `Test-MoeAccountWaitAttempt`, with its comment block, between Get-MoeAccountLease's closing `}` and `# Process-scoped Git hooks...` (8923). It does the following, in order:
- return $true when `-not $script:AccountLeaseWaited`, or when `$script:MoeAttemptId` is empty or `$script:MoeAttemptGeneration` is $null;
- return $true when `Read-MoeAttempt $preflightTaskId $script:MoeAttemptId $script:MoeAttemptGeneration` returns a record. On failure it prints its own `[WARN] Attempt identity unavailable: ...` and sets $script:MoeAttemptReadError;
- otherwise Write-Host -ForegroundColor Yellow exactly `[account] MOE_ACCOUNT_WAIT_STALE_ATTEMPT task=$preflightTaskId attempt=$($script:MoeAttemptId) generation=$($script:MoeAttemptGeneration) ($($script:MoeAttemptReadError)) - the claim ended while this seat waited for an account; not launching the pre-wait prompt, re-running pre-flight now.` This is byte-identical to the sh line for the same state; the test asserts the same text on every engine;
- then `if ($moeGit) { Remove-MoeLiveMarker $moeGit.GitDir $preflightTaskId }`, `Clear-MoeAccountLease`, `if ($script:ResumeAttempts -gt 0) { $script:ResumeAttempts-- }`, `$script:AccountRelaunch = $true`, and `return $false`.
(3) At the call site (10155), right after `        Get-MoeAccountLease`: `        if (-not (Test-MoeAccountWaitAttempt)) { continue }`.
PowerShell traps:
- `continue` inside the main `do { } while (...)` jumps to its condition (11329). Under -NoLoop, $loopEnabled is false, so `$script:AccountRelaunch = $true` is what keeps the loop running. The dry-run mutant without it ended the run with no launch on powershell.exe and pwsh.exe.
- Never put `continue` inside the function: PowerShell propagates break/continue out of functions dynamically.
- Use Write-Host only. Any stray pipeline output would join the return value and flip `-not (...)`.
- The worktree-mode Push-Location just before the lease is popped at the next iteration's top (9296), so `continue` needs no Pop-Location.
Error handling: a Read-MoeAttempt throw is already caught inside it and returns $null, which counts as not current. The seat launches nothing and re-runs pre-flight, and is never ended or deregistered.
Check: ParseFile under powershell.exe (5.1). The dry run also parsed it under pwsh 7.6.

Document the behavior in scripts/CLAUDE.md, in the **Claude account rotation** bullet. Use the exact text from fix.diff's scripts/CLAUDE.md hunk.
(1) Right after the sentence ending "so the REVIEW self-heal leaves a waiting QA seat's row held.", insert one sentence:
A wait can still outlive the claim (a release or a peer's claim while the seat sleeps), so after any wait in the lease loop (this one or `MOE_ACCOUNT_UNTRUSTED` below) the wrapper re-reads the attempt it pinned at pre-flight before launching (`account_wait_recheck` / `Test-MoeAccountWaitAttempt`): a closed or superseded one launches nothing (`MOE_ACCOUNT_WAIT_STALE_ATTEMPT`), and the seat drops its live-session marker, gives the resume attempt back and re-runs pre-flight at once, even under `--no-loop`, for a fresh claim, context and pin; a lease that did not wait launches as before.
(2) In that bullet's Tests list, right after the moe-account-lease.test.mjs entry, add:
`scripts/tests/account-wait-attempt.test.mjs` (the post-wait attempt re-check of both launchers on every engine),
No other doc changes. docs/MCP_SERVER.md's lease_account section describes the daemon's side, which is unchanged.

comments.content:
RED evidence (DoD 2), worker-c9368191, 2026-11-03. The new scripts/tests/account-wait-attempt.test.mjs (sha256 cdf71c64…, identical to the plan's reference) was overlaid on a `git archive <rev> scripts` copy and run against the unfixed wrappers. Rev 19d5e67a (the DoD base) and rev 195b656a (the current task base, which adds 6d6bdc51's ps1 edits) give the same result.

- WSL node 24, /bin/bash: tests 4, pass 2, fail 2.
- Windows node.exe: tests 12, pass 6, fail 6 (powershell.exe, pwsh.exe and Git Bash).

The failing rows on every engine are:
- "a pin closed during the account wait launches nothing and re-runs pre-flight"
- "an untrusted-account wait re-verifies the pin the same way"

The rows that pass are "a pin still current after the wait launches on it" and "a lease that did not wait keeps the launch path unchanged".

In each failing row, the unfixed wrapper launches on the closed pin right after the lease:
```
[account] MOE_ACCOUNT_LEASED account=acct-1 usage=10%
LAUNCH task=task-wait attempt=attempt-a generation=6 resume=1
```
The assertion diff is:
```
actual:   [ 'LAUNCH task=task-wait attempt=attempt-a generation=6 resume=1' ]
expected: [ 'LAUNCH task=task-next attempt=attempt-c generation=1 resume=0' ]
```
Commands: `node --test scripts/tests/account-wait-attempt.test.mjs` and `"/mnt/c/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe" --test 'scripts\tests\account-wait-attempt.test.mjs'`, run in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/red-a7d0-<rev>.

planSizeWarnings: Plan touches 6 distinct files (target <=5); plans over 10 are rejected. Small file-disjoint tasks review better and parallelize.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: When a claude seat's account lease waited (every signed-in account spent, or an account that does not trust the project), and the attempt pinned at pre-flight is no longer this seat's current attempt in .moe/attempts (closed, superseded by a peer's claim, missing, or not running/finalizing), neither launcher starts the CLI from the pre-wait prompt. It prints `[account] MOE_ACCOUNT_WAIT_STALE_ATTEMPT task=<id> attempt=<id> generation=<n> (<reason>) - the claim ended while this seat waited for an account; not launching the pre-wait prompt, re-running pre-flight now.`. It then drops only its own live-session marker, gives the resume attempt back, and re-runs pre-flight at once: an account relaunch with no poll sleep, even under --no-loop / -NoLoop. So the next pass claims, fetches context and pins afresh. A lease that did not wait, a seat with no pinned attempt, or a pin that is still current launches exactly as before.
acceptanceCriteria: moe-agent.sh: get_account_lease resets ACCOUNT_LEASE_WAITED=false first and sets it true before each idle_wait. account_wait_recheck re-reads the pin with moe_attempt_read only after a wait. The launch block calls `account_wait_recheck || continue` right after get_account_lease.

moe-agent.ps1: the same in Get-MoeAccountLease ($script:AccountLeaseWaited) and Test-MoeAccountWaitAttempt (Read-MoeAttempt). The call site is `if (-not (Test-MoeAccountWaitAttempt)) { continue }`, and the stale branch sets $script:AccountRelaunch so a -NoLoop do/while runs another pass.

scripts/tests/account-wait-attempt.test.mjs (new) runs on every available engine: bash (Linux / Git Bash), powershell.exe and pwsh.exe. A pin closed during the wait (also the untrusted-account wait) launches nothing and re-runs pre-flight onto a fresh attempt; a still-current pin and a lease that did not wait launch on the pinned attempt.
Against 19d5e67a's wrappers the two stale rows fail on every engine: LAUNCH on attempt-a. That RED evidence is in a task comment.
bash -n, PS 5.1 ParseFile and bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh pass. moe-account-lease.test.mjs passes on WSL and Windows, including its formerly failing bash rows.
invariants: After a lease that waited, the CLI is never launched on a pin that moe_attempt_read / Read-MoeAttempt no longer reads as this seat's open running/finalizing attempt.
The restart never exits or deregisters the seat, removes only this session's own live-session marker, and sends no RPC.
Both twins share the same semantics and print the identical MOE_ACCOUNT_WAIT_STALE_ATTEMPT line for the same state.
No variable named MOE_ACCOUNT_* is added, because parity-check would read it as a code.
compatibility: The wait messages are unchanged. parity-check pins 'every signed-in account is spent; the held task stays held. (Ctrl+C to stop)' in both twins.
The no-wait launch path is unchanged, and so is a seat with no pinned attempt.
No daemon, proxy or MCP contract change. The proxy's execution-identity fence is untouched.
approvedScope: scripts/moe-agent.sh: get_account_lease (the ACCOUNT_LEASE_WAITED flag lines), new account_wait_recheck, one call line in the launch block.
scripts/moe-agent.ps1: Get-MoeAccountLease ($script:AccountLeaseWaited lines), new Test-MoeAccountWaitAttempt, one call line in the launch block.
New operator code MOE_ACCOUNT_WAIT_STALE_ATTEMPT (MOE_ACCOUNT_ family, both twins).
Tests: new scripts/tests/account-wait-attempt.test.mjs; the idle_wait cut in scripts/tests/moe-account-lease.test.mjs shLeaseScript.
CI: the new file is added to .github/workflows/ci.yml 'Test agent runtime discovery'. Docs: one sentence plus a test-list entry in the scripts/CLAUDE.md Claude account rotation bullet.

live_marker_remove / Remove-MoeLiveMarker (own marker only), clear_account_lease / Clear-MoeAccountLease, and ACCOUNT_RELAUNCH / $script:AccountRelaunch: the existing immediate-relaunch path, which also keeps a -NoLoop run going.
The test harness reuses moe-account-lease.test.mjs's shape: between() cuts, a scripted lease_account, and stubbed sleep / Start-Sleep.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
Rejected alternatives:
(1) Lease an account BEFORE claiming. It would reflow the launch block, which the description forbids because the CQ-M07 lane edits these files, and it would change the documented hold.
(2) Run the heartbeat during the wait. 0c78c290 already counts lease polls as presence, and presence cannot help when a governor releases the row or the daemon restarts.
(3) Have the proxy adopt the attempt from a relayed claim_next_task. That touches the execution-identity fence; the description says to make it a separate row.
(4) Re-check after every lease. DoD 1 requires the no-wait path unchanged.
(5) A full-wrapper postflight arm. postflight.ps1 is held by 65b3e023, and the fake proxy is shared by many harnesses. The slice harness runs the REAL lease loop, pin and launch lines in about 1 s per row.
(6) A bare `continue`. ps1's do/while would end a -NoLoop run without launching (dry-run mutant M7), so both twins set the account-relaunch flag.
(7) Run the normal post-flight instead of `continue`. For a row the seat no longer owns, it would record refused or nothing-to-commit landing rows and a session-ended line, which is noise. The re-check instead drops only its own marker, which is the one artifact post-flight would clean.
The wait messages are left unchanged (optional in the description).
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- pin_attempt_identity / Set-MoeAttemptIdentity pin at pre-flight, before the lease (sh 10011 vs 10741; ps1 9622 vs 10155).
- moe_attempt_read / Read-MoeAttempt read .moe/attempts directly. They require exactly one non-closed attempt for the task, owned by this worker, in running or finalizing, with a matching id and generation.
- The loop top reads ACCOUNT_RELAUNCH to skip the poll sleep, and in ps1 it is also part of the do/while condition.
- The pre-flight top blanks the attempt pair and PREFLIGHT_TASK_ID, so `continue` cannot leak the stale pin.
- A live-session marker is removed only when its first line matches the line this session wrote.
- parity-check section 1 compares the MOE_ACCOUNT_ family across twins, so the new code needs no parity-check edit.
- The architect dry run (/mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-a7d0, dryrun.txt) proved all of this: the checkRef green (WSL 45/44/0/1, Windows 67/65/0/2), RED on 19d5e67a (2 and 6 fails), and mutants M1-M8 each caught.
planningNotes.risks:
- The moe-account-lease.test.mjs bash break is pre-existing; without step 1(b) the gate is red.
- Moving a cut anchor breaks this test and others; keep them byte-identical.
- PowerShell traps: output pollution flips the bool; `continue` inside a function propagates dynamically; dropping $script:AccountRelaunch ends a -NoLoop run.
- macOS bash 3.2: the new lines must use only 3.2 syntax.
- The ps1 line numbers in the task description are about 88 lines stale.
- Edit the worktree copies in place with a TOOL-witnessed editor, then bash -n / ParseFile. The atomic-save rule applies only to the shared checkout.
- Mutants go in a copy outside W.
- The Windows node.exe leg needs the worktree on D: (true for .worktrees/), and powershell.exe/pwsh.exe/python on PATH (present on this host).
